message: Email 1, draft 1: "Turn one IT procedure into a guide"
subject: Turn one IT procedure into a guide
preview_text: Try browser-based guide generation on Scribe’s free Basic plan.
body:
If a browser-based IT procedure currently lives in one person’s head, perform it once and turn it into a how-to guide.

Scribe is documentation and workflow-capture software that turns actions taken in applications into step-by-step how-to guides your IT team can follow.

With Autocapture, Scribe turns work you have already performed into Scribes automatically. The procedure becomes a practical guide instead of a separate writing project.

The free Basic plan lets you generate how-to guides in the browser, so you can test one real procedure at no cost. Desktop application capture requires Pro or Enterprise.
call_to_action: Sign up and create a guide

message: Email 1, draft 2: "Document IT work with redaction"
subject: Document IT work with redaction
preview_text: Turn a browser procedure into a guide while sensitive data is automatically redacted.
body:
Take one browser-based IT procedure and turn the performed work into documentation. Scribe is workflow-capture software that converts actions taken in applications into step-by-step how-to guides.

Scribe’s Autocapture turns work already completed into guides automatically. During capture, Scribe automatically redacts 150 categories of PII, PHI, and PCI, helping keep sensitive details out of the result.

The Basic plan is **free** and lets you generate how-to guides in the browser. That gives you a concrete way to judge Scribe using one real IT procedure before considering broader use.

Desktop application capture requires Pro or Enterprise. For your first test, choose a browser-based procedure and see whether the resulting guide fits your team’s internal documentation.
